verdict.rationale: LegalOS is an AI-assisted immigration platform with attorney review, so asking whether its software can be self-hosted is a fair question. However, the evidence only describes a managed service where preparation, attorney review and filing stay "within one accountable immigration team." Nothing mentions self-hosting, on-prem deployment, downloadable software or open-source code, and the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
